lore_anchors.definition: A legendary, sentient spirit herb that can transform into animate forms like a white rabbit; its capture represents a major alchemical prize in the Mortal Stream.
The innate Yang-aligned lightning released by Gold Lightning Bamboo, considered a perfect counter against Yin-type evil and ghostly entities.
The signature cultivation technique of Extreme Yin Patriarch, associated with vast black clouds and overwhelming Yin-type power.
